title: Redefining Instance Matching: A Unified Framework for Part-Aware Matching in Panoptic Segmentation Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2605.31094v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The Panoptic Quality metric is the standard for jointly evaluating instance and semantic segmentation. Its original definition matches predicted and ground truth segments only if their intersection over union exceeds 0.5, a threshold that guarantees a One-to-One matching that is both optimal and unique. Below this threshold, the uniqueness guarantee is lost and multiple matching strategies emerge in a poorly explored problem space. We systematically elucidate this space by recasting segment matching as a constrained bipartite assignment problem. Independently bounding the prediction- and ground-truth-side degrees yields four matching strategies: One-to-One, Many-to-One, One-to-Many, and Many-to-Many. We show that the first three yield interpretable instance-level assignments, whereas Many-to-Many entangles over- and under-segmentation and admits no consistent attribution of errors. translated_title: 重新定义实例匹配：全景分割评估中部件感知匹配的统一框架
translated_abstract: 全景质量指标是联合评估实例分割与语义分割的标准。其原始定义仅在预测分割与真实分割的交并比超过0.5时才进行匹配，这一阈值保证了既最优又唯一的一对一匹配。低于该阈值时，唯一性保证不复存在，多种匹配策略在一个探索甚少的问题空间中涌现。我们通过将分割匹配重新表述为一个受约束的二部指派问题，系统地阐明了这一空间。通过独立约束预测侧与真实侧的度数，我们得到四种匹配策略：一对一、多对一、一对多和多对多。我们证明前三种策略能够产生可解释的实例级指派，而多对多策略则将过分割与欠分割纠缠在一起，无法对错误进行一致的归因。这些策略在实例……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文将全景分割评估中的片段匹配重新表述为受约束的二部图指派问题，通过独立约束预测侧与真实侧的度数定义了四种匹配策略（一对一、多对一、一对多、多对多），并证明除多对多之外的前三种策略均能给出可解释的实例级错误归因。
en_tdlr: This paper reformulates segment matching in panoptic segmentation evaluation as a constrained bipartite assignment problem, defining four matching strategies (One-to-One, Many-to-One, One-to-Many, and Many-to-Many) by independently bounding the degrees on both sides, and shows that all but Many-to-Many yield interpretable instance-level error attribution.
